summary.headline: Jupiter’s Phases in the Signs
summary.text: Predictions for Jupiter’s eastern and western phases in Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, and Sagittarius, including weather, disease, unrest, royal afflictions, deaths, and military conditions. Hermes gives differing omens for Jupiter’s western phase in the first, second, and third thirds of each sign.
